en: Black‑and‑white river view showing a side‑wheel steam tug or paddlesteamer pushing or towing a long barge. In the background, across a wide river, is a small European village with scattered houses and a prominent neo‑Gothic church with a tall pointed spire. The landscape is flat to gently rolling, with fields and a line of trees along the riverbank. No visible caption or border is present on the front.
